text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet is exhausted, so I decide to bring her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Good grief. It's really not a big deal… but if it'll make you happy, then whatever.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Where the heck am I?! Trainer? Are you there?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Eek! No way… Is that a zombie?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aaah! I hate horror films! Stay away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet lashes out blindly and lands a clean roundhouse kick on the zombie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At that moment, a bright light floods the room.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that… just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That zombie did seem pretty weak. I mean, I am number one, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Revitalized, Daiwa Scarlet leaves the infirmary with a spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing Daiwa Scarlet scream, the zombie shambles forward and attacks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At that moment, a bright light floods the room.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: W-was that…just a d-dream?! More like a nightmare… I'm never going to be able to sleep tonight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to forget the dream she had, Daiwa Scarlet fails to get a proper rest.
